readme: SYNTHETIC example of the brain eval golden set (real sets live at <WAPP_WORK_DIR>/eval/golden-queries.json and never enter git). Each query: stable id, class (canonical: paraphrase / person / commitment / temporal / code-mixed — open vocabulary), the query text as you'd type it into search, and expect: source message keys (wa|<chatSourceId>|<sourceMessageId>) the search should surface. Bump version on edit; every eval run records a content hash so runs are only compared within identical golden content.

queries.note: Original message says 'let's see the flat on Saturday' — no keyword overlap with 'apartment visit'.
Sender resolution: the message stores only a raw JID; resolved_text carries the display name.
Two messages: the promise and its confirmation.
Romanized Hindi; recall gates must exercise transliteration variance ('nhi' vs 'nahi').
Same target message as codemix-nahi-aa-raha but queried with the shorthand variant ('nhi'); recovered by the term-alias layer at the exact tier, no model call.
